title: S7_template_normalization QC Status
description: QC status schema for S7_template_normalization step (aggregated per dataset key)

anat_to_pam50_init_method.description: Method used by S2 for the anat->PAM50 init warp (carried forward from S2 QC)

cord_dice_native_func.description: Overall 3D Dice between PAM50_cord (warped to native func) and the S6 native func cord seg. Headline gate (Cohen-Adad 2014).

cord_dice_per_level.description: Per-spinal-level cord Dice. Keys are stringified PAM50_spinal_levels integers (1..30: 1-8 C1-C8, 9-20 T1-T12, 21-25 L1-L5, 26-30 S1-S5; cervical FOV usually 1..~9); values are Dice restricted to that level's Z slices. Kaptan 2023 / CoSpine 2025 / Valošek 2025 standard.

vertebral_level_coverage.description: Sorted list of PAM50_spinal_levels integers present in the BOLD FOV.

cord_round_trip_med_mm.description: Median per-Z cord centroid drift on forward∘inverse warp (cord-mask-restricted, replaces the FOV-wide intensity-weighted COM).

cord_round_trip_max_mm.description: Max per-Z cord centroid drift, same metric family.

pam50_on_func.description: Composite registration QC view: tall-narrow sagittal pair (funcref + PAM50 spinal_levels color blocks) + 3 cord-bearing axial tiles with PAM50_cord (yellow) and EPI-cord (cyan) contours.

cord_dice_per_level.description: Per-vertebral-level 3D Dice bar chart with PASS/WARN/FAIL color bands. Kaptan 2023 / CoSpine 2025 / Valošek 2025 standard.

xfm_paths.description: Relative paths to composite warps + provenance
